metadata.description: Personal portfolio marketplace: reusable capabilities shared across all coding agents (Prompt OS routing, campaign production, DigitalOcean ops, ElevenLabs media, Clerk auth).

plugins.name: use-prompt-os
plugins.description: Entry point to the Notion Portfolio Prompt OS: identify the app, fetch the Prompt Router, select one Agent-Ready workflow, resolve dependencies, execute within boundaries, and record the run.

plugins.name: use-campaign-production
plugins.description: Orchestrate creative campaign production (launches, social packs, sales collateral, presentations, event kits, brand variants, customer stories) by routing to the owned creative tool adapters.

plugins.name: use-digitalocean
plugins.description: Operate the DigitalOcean portfolio across App Platform, Droplets, DNS, managed databases, Spaces, inference, and incidents via the authenticated doctl CLI.

plugins.name: use-elevenlabs
plugins.description: ElevenLabs media: account health, reusable API/CLI environment, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech, with a strict local-first policy for privileged media.

plugins.name: clerk
plugins.description: Clerk authentication integration for portfolio apps.

plugins.name: firecrawl-ops
plugins.description: Research, extract, QA, and monitor live web sources through Firecrawl while keeping MCP ownership centralized in AgentHub.
